about: What each everyday CE tool leaves in the CE logs on Tim's PC. ran = CE logged that the command ran and how it ended. did = CE logged a sentence that shows what it did. weak = indirect evidence only. silent = no, partly or yes: does the tool leave NO proof of its result in the log. Patterns are .NET regular expressions, matched against one log line. Written from the real logs (28 to 29 Oct 2026) and from the robot cases in C:\Lisp Files\_ACAD_DRIVER\cases. A log line proves the command ran and CE printed that sentence. It does not prove the drawing looks right.

knownNonTimWindows.who: Codex looks G1 and G2 (reports CODEX_VERIFY_G1 and G2, 28 Oct)

ignoreLines: CE could not find this drawing's job folder

failPatterns.pattern: Pit schedule refresh after a command left
the project record was the drawing's only unsaved change

tools.name: PIT and CD keep placing until Esc
tools.silentWhat: The repeat prompt and the Esc sentence are command-line only. The log shows each command finished, not that it offered the next one.

tools.name: Pit catches a pipe end within outline + 100 mm
tools.silentWhat: The sentence 'Pipe end moved to the inside wall of ...' is command-line only. Only the endpoint review lines hint at it.

tools.name: New pipe end joins the only matching pit
tools.silentWhat: The flow line 'Flow: P8 -> Open end' is command-line only. The log shows Connected or Unresolved for each end.

tools.name: Esc at CD's third point cancels cleanly
tools.silentWhat: Only 'Command outcome: CD cancelled' proves a cancelled CD. The line 'CD command cancelled by user' also prints when Esc simply ends CD after a pipe was placed (outcome then says completed), so it is a weak hint only. The empty drawing and no pipe window are not logged.
weak: CD command cancelled (during draw-first point collection|by user)

tools.name: Recent diameter/material/levels in New Pipe window
tools.silentWhat: Nothing is logged for the window's fields. The file CD_RecentValues.json changes when values are remembered (file time shown below).

tools.name: Hide grade on every pipe type
tools.silentWhat: A window setting. Nothing is logged.

tools.name: DP and CDRG place like pits, before pipes
tools.silentWhat: 'Downpipe placed. Tag: DP1' is command-line only. The log shows the command ended and any source refusal.
weak: \[Source\] The source name '\w+' is on \d+ blocks

tools.name: OF and FO share one symbol, different tag
tools.silentWhat: 'Overflow placed. Tag: OF1.' is command-line only.

tools.name: Pit label shows number and cover level
tools.silentWhat: The label text (P8, CL 19.000) is not logged. The pit being added and its cover level being set are.

tools.name: Pipe label mid-pipe ('100 DIA. UPVC PIPE AT 1 IN 100')
tools.silentWhat: Label text and position are not logged.

tools.name: Short pipe label goes out on a leader
tools.silentWhat: A leader is a picture item. Nothing is logged.

tools.name: One IL text per pipe end at the pit
tools.silentWhat: The IL texts are not logged.

tools.name: Hand-placed label stays after an edit
tools.silentWhat: Only Tidy labels says it left a label alone, and only with the switch ON (Tim's file has it OFF).
did: was placed by hand, so it stays

tools.name: ERASE a pit: pipes stay, one U restores
tools.silentWhat: The U that restores it leaves only the generic Undo lines.
did: \[DeletionReactor\] The pit was erased and the schedule is updated

tools.name: COPY a pit: real CE copy, own number
tools.silentWhat: '1 pit copied and numbered as new' is command-line only. The label text is not logged.
did: was copied from pit \S+ before CE re-mapped copies

tools.name: EXPLODE a pit: allowed, with a note
did: \[UX-EDIT-04\] P\d+ is now plain linework and has left the schedule

tools.name: CDEDIT keeps the selection
tools.silentWhat: That the pipes are still selected afterwards is not logged.

tools.name: CE never saves the drawing
tools.silentWhat: No log line says 'file not saved'. 'Project data saved to DWG successfully' is CE writing its record INSIDE the open drawing, not saving the file: do not read it as a save. Only the file date on disk proves this.

tools.name: Every CE Undo step has a plain name
tools.silentWhat: The Undo echo ('U PIT') and 'Undid: ...' are command-line only. The log shows that an Undo or Redo happened.

tools.name: CDRENUMBER: outlet first, downhill to uphill
tools.silentWhat: The list, the Yes/No question and the Pit Schedule result are command-line or window only. Yes leaves temporary-number lines; No leaves none.

tools.name: Pit Schedule in natural order (P1, P2 ... P10)
tools.silentWhat: The row order is not logged.

tools.name: Long Pit Schedule continues on the next sheet
tools.silentWhat: The continuation part is not logged.

tools.name: Excel export with a checking sheet
tools.silentWhat: The Export Excel button writes no log line. The saved .xlsx file on disk is the only trace.

tools.name: CE objects land on office layers, current layer kept
tools.silentWhat: A drawing look. Nothing is logged.

tools.name: Existing greyed, demolished dashed (NOT BUILT)
tools.silentWhat: Not built, so nothing to find.

tools.name: CDSL shows the survey level as existing
tools.silentWhat: The level text and the 18600 refusal are command-line only.

tools.name: CDSYNC and CDREBUILD warn before they run
tools.silentWhat: The warning sentence and the counts ('Pits relinked: 12') are command-line only. The log shows the command ended.

tools.name: CDCHECKDWG ends with one summary line
tools.silentWhat: The one summary line is command-line only. A cdcheck report file is saved (file time shown below).

tools.name: CDFEEDBACK prints one honest result line
tools.silentWhat: The log does not say whether Send or Cancel was pressed (not verified which word it writes for Cancel).

tools.name: Selecting a pipe or pit jumps to its ribbon tab
tools.silentWhat: A ribbon change. Nothing is logged.

CD (daily regression)

did: \[PitMove\] pit \S+ moved .*pipes relinked, label and cover text followed

tools.name: Named check: BUG-1225 DP and OF after a drawing is reopened
tools.silentWhat: The reopen line 'was opened again after its drawing closed' printed in the robot's reopens (25 times since 28 Oct) but NOT in Tim's own reopen of 29 Oct 09:21 (only the 'drawing that owns CE's record closed' line printed). The proof that matters is the DP or OF outcome line AFTER the close line, with no 'Final landing refresh refused' or 'Nothing will be placed here' line.

weak: \[BUG-1225\] The drawing that owns CE's record closed
